caption: The drawing depicts a metal coffee pot with a conical body, a spout on the left side, and a curved handle attached near the top rim on the right side. The pot has a circular lid with a small knob on top, and a decorated band running around this lid as well as the upper section of the body, featuring yellow and red floral or foliate motifs. The main surface of the pot is a weathered, dark brownish-purple color. On the largest section of the body, there is a prominent decorative pattern with stylized circular shapes in shades of red and yellow, surrounded by yellow, black, and light gray elements, suggesting a floral or abstract design. The coffee pot is centered on a plain, off-white background with a faint rectangular border sketched around it. There are a few small spots or marks visible on the background, and a faint artist’s signature is written near the lower right corner.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
